# Brain coral: a squat, lumpy dome, 1.1 m across, 0.55 m tall, with a ring of darker folds round its
# foot. Up Z.
new
material new Brain --base-color 0.0 0.725 0.745 --no-slot
material new Fold --base-color 0.0 0.373 0.549 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Brain --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.55 --location 0 0 0.12
scale 1 1 0.75
apply --scale --location
material assign Brain
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 8
select face where "pos.z < 0.12 && pos.z > -0.05"
material assign Fold
mode object
shade flat
export coral_brain.glb
